capabilities: poll a backend server for new WeChat articles and save them as Markdown
download WeChat CDN images into the vault
run automatic sync on a configurable interval
trigger manual sync from the status bar, ribbon, or command palette
extras: The README is written in Chinese. The plugin only works after the user deploys the companion backend server and configures its URL and API token; it is the Obsidian client of the larger WeChat Obsidian Sync project. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Articles read in WeChat are not directly accessible to Obsidian, and WeChat CDN image links expire, so saved articles lose their pictures.

relations.evidence: 本插件是 WeChat Obsidian Sync 项目的一部分，需要配合后端服务器使用。
wechat-clipper — 微信小程序「收藏助手」

requires.name: API Token shared with the backend server

summary: Syncs WeChat Official Account articles into the vault as Markdown via a backend server, archiving them by date and downloading images locally.
